narrative.overview: Light, neutral and minimal, as selected by the user. Content and familiar pagination lead; the page is an operating surface, not a promotional landing page. Local fictional poster illustrations provide visual distinction without external fonts or image services.
dos: Do preserve readable titles, visible focus, responsive whole-card reflow and explicit UI states.
Do bundle fixture assets locally and keep synthetic content clearly labelled.
donts: Don't expose future functionality as working controls or make cards appear clickable when no details exist.
Don't recolor, stretch or prominently feature the TMDB mark above the application name.
